_help: Refurbished machines you source yourself. Add one block per machine, then commit; it appears in the shop at the next update. price = what the client pays, including GST (your cost incl. GST and delivery x 1.25, rounded up to $5). Don't put your buy price here: this file is public. Set "sold": true (or delete the block) when it's gone. Photos: put a file in photos/ named after the part (e.g. photos/LAT7310-01.jpg) or paste an image link in "image". Never put the seller's name here; this file is public.
